llm.domain: Movie Ontology. Single sentences extracted from Wikipedia articles.

Film.description: An entity of the type "film", as defined by the Movie Ontology.

name.description: The text that identifies this Film in the source text.
name.instructions: Use the exact surface form as it appears in the source text, without adding, removing, reordering or normalizing any words.

publication_date.description: The "publication date" of this Film, as defined by the Movie Ontology.
publication_date.instructions: Only fill this field when the source text explicitly states it; otherwise leave it empty. Each value must use the exact surface form as it appears in the source text, without normalizing its words. When the text states several values, for instance as an enumeration, extract each value on its own and separate them with ";": "written for violin, cello and piano" gives "violin; cello; piano". Dates must be written in the format "<DD> <Month> <YYYY>". When the source text states only a year, use "01 January <YYYY>".

main_subject.description: The "main subject" of this Film, as defined by the Movie Ontology.
main_subject.instructions: Only fill this field when the source text explicitly states it; otherwise leave it empty. Each value must use the exact surface form as it appears in the source text, without normalizing its words. When the text states several values, for instance as an enumeration, extract each value on its own and separate them with ";": "written for violin, cello and piano" gives "violin; cello; piano".
